lines.text: What does it cost to get them washed and pressed?
Two taps on Juniper Lane: shirts, then wash and press.
$2.50 a shirt. Most orders are back in 48 hours.
lines.say: Two dollars fifty a shirt. Most orders are back in forty-eight hours.

lines.text: Free pickup and delivery on orders over $30.
lines.say: Free pickup and delivery on orders over thirty dollars.

lines.text: Next time: what does a duvet cost?
lines.say: [curious] Next time: what does a duvet cost?
